developerConsoleUrl.reasoning: The hint points to the Shopify Partners dashboard where apps are created and managed, which is the de‑facto developer console.

summary: Shopify lets developers create OAuth apps through the Partners dashboard in a fully self‑serve manner; credentials (API key and secret) are issued instantly. After submission, the app may undergo a quality‑check review that can require human response and up to 30 days to address, but there is no mandatory fee or mandatory public listing for basic API access.

selfServeMinutes.reasoning: Creating an app in the dashboard and copying the generated client ID/secret typically takes under a quarter of an hour for a developer familiar with the UI.

reviewWaitBusinessDays.reasoning: Docs describe a 30‑day window to fix issues after a quality check and a 7‑day response deadline, but they do not state how long the initial review itself takes before a quality check is issued.

steps.title: Log into the Shopify Partner Dashboard
steps.detail: Open https://partners.shopify.com/current/apps and sign in with your Partner account.

steps.title: Create a new app entry
steps.detail: In the dashboard click **Create app** → choose **Public app** (or **Custom app** for private use) and give the app a name.

steps.title: Configure OAuth redirect URIs
steps.detail: In the **App setup** section add each redirect endpoint (e.g. https://myapp.example.com/auth/callback) to the **Redirect URLs** field and save.
steps.where: Partner Dashboard > App > App setup > Redirect URLs

steps.title: Select required OAuth scopes
steps.detail: Review the scopes listed in your shopify.app.toml file and add only those that correspond to shipped features. Declare optional scopes for features that are not universally used and plan to request them on‑demand. Remove any unused scopes and, when possible, downgrade optional write scopes to read‑only as of API version 2027‑01.
steps.where: Partner Dashboard > App > App setup > OAuth scopes

citations.quote: Review your `shopify.app.toml` file and remove scopes that no shipped feature uses.
citations.title: Request only the scopes you use

citations.quote: If only some stores use a feature, then declare the scopes that it needs as optional scopes, and request them when an app user turns the feature on.
citations.title: Request only the scopes you use

citations.quote: When your app no longer needs an optional scope, revoke it.
citations.title: Request only the scopes you use

citations.quote: Starting with GraphQL Admin API version `2027-01`, your app can also downgrade an optional write scope to read.
citations.title: Request only the scopes you use

steps.title: Save the app to generate credentials
steps.detail: Click **Save**; the dashboard will display the **API key (Client ID)** and **API secret key** which you will use in your OAuth flow.

steps.title: Submit the app for review (public apps)
steps.detail: After configuring the app, go to **App submission**, provide evidence of any required changes (e.g., updated shopify.app.toml), and click **Submit**. This starts the Shopify quality‑check review process.

citations.quote: After you make the changes, submit your response in the Partner Dashboard and provide evidence of the changes that you've made.
citations.title: App quality checks

nuances.title: App eligibility prerequisites
nuances.detail: Your app must already have at least 50 net installs on paid‑plan shops, a minimum of five reviews, and meet Shopify’s recent rating threshold before you can submit it for public review.

citations.quote: Your app must have a minimum of 50 net installs from active shops on paid plans.
citations.title: App launch requirements

citations.quote: Your app must have a minimum of five reviews.
citations.title: App launch requirements

citations.quote: Your app must meet a minimum recent app rating threshold in the Shopify App Store.
citations.title: App launch requirements

nuances.title: Scope management gotchas
nuances.detail: Only request scopes that are actively used. Optional scopes must be declared and requested at runtime; unused optional scopes should be revoked. From API version 2027‑01 you can downgrade optional write scopes to read‑only, reducing review friction.

nuances.title: 30‑day remediation window
nuances.detail: If required changes are not made within 30 days after a quality‑check request, Shopify may unpublish the app.

citations.quote: If you fail to make required changes to your app within 30 days, then your app might be unpublished.
citations.title: App quality checks

whenBlocked.situation: App does not meet the 50‑install / 5‑review / rating prerequisites
whenBlocked.action: Contact Shopify Partner Support via the Partner Dashboard support form to request a review of eligibility or to get guidance on meeting the thresholds.

openQuestions.question: What is the typical turnaround time for the initial quality‑check review before a developer receives a response?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Knowing the review wait informs the total time from app creation to usable credentials.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Locate a Shopify support or developer forum statement that specifies the average review duration, or a doc page that mentions a fixed review SLA.

openQuestions.question: Is there any cost (one‑time or recurring) associated with registering a private OAuth app on Shopify?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Cost affects the barrier to entry for developers building agents.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Check Shopify pricing pages or partner agreement sections for any mention of fees for private app registration.

sources.quote: If your quality check has a list of changes that you need to make to your app, then you have 30 days to make those changes.
If you don't respond to the initial quality check within 7 days, then your app will be demoted.
Your app must have a minimum of 50 net installs from active shops on paid plans.
Your app must have a minimum of five reviews.
Your app must meet a minimum recent app rating threshold in the Shopify App Store.
All Shopify App Store apps must comply with the Partner Program Agreement
